create_d4pg_config_with_defaults: create a D4PGConfig instance using all default values for sigma, discount, and batch size
customize_d4pg_learning_rate: customize the D4PGConfig learning rate and batch size for faster training on a GPU
configure_d4pg_replay_options: configure the D4PGConfig min replay size and max replay size for memory constrained environments
adjust_d4pg_n_step_and_discount: adjust the D4PGConfig n step and discount parameters to tune temporal difference learning
set_d4pg_target_update_period: set the D4PGConfig target update period and sigma for noisy network exploration
